arguments.subject: Detailed WiFi setup guide & answers to your questions
arguments.body:
Hi Brian,

Here are detailed answers to your questions:

PEAK USAGE TIME: This is when your household has the most devices active simultaneously - typically 7-10 PM when people stream, game, video call, etc. Test WiFi strength during these hours.

MEASURING SQUARE FOOTAGE:
1. Check your property tax records or home appraisal
2. Use a measuring app on your phone
3. Measure each room (length x width) and add up
Most homes under 5,000 sq ft are fine with 3 nodes, but layout matters more than size.

WHY NIGHTTIME DROPS HAPPEN:
- Neighbors' WiFi interference increases when they're home
- Household devices (smart TVs, consoles) activate at night
- Some routers auto-switch channels at night causing brief drops

ABSOLUTE GUARANTEE:
While I can't guarantee 100% perfection (WiFi depends on interference, building materials, etc.), here's my commitment:
1. Replacement unit undergoes extra hardware testing
2. If issues persist after 7 days, I'll arrange FREE 4th node or full refund
3. I'll follow up personally next week to check your setup

The replacement ships tomorrow. Let me know if you need anything else!

Best,
TechMart Support

arguments.subject: Detailed WiFi setup guide & answers to your questions
arguments.body:
Hi Brian,

Here are detailed answers to your questions:

PEAK USAGE TIME: This is when your household has the most devices active simultaneously - typically 7-10 PM when people stream, game, video call, etc. Test WiFi strength during these hours.

MEASURING SQUARE FOOTAGE:
1. Check your property tax records or home appraisal
2. Use a measuring app on your phone
3. Measure each room (length x width) and add up
Most homes under 5,000 sq ft are fine with 3 nodes, but layout matters more than size.

WHY NIGHTTIME DROPS HAPPEN:
- Neighbors' WiFi interference increases when they're home
- Household devices (smart TVs, consoles) activate at night
- Some routers auto-switch channels at night causing brief drops

ABSOLUTE GUARANTEE:
While I can't guarantee 100% perfection (WiFi depends on interference, building materials, etc.), here's my commitment:
1. Replacement unit undergoes extra hardware testing
2. If issues persist after 7 days, I'll arrange FREE 4th node or full refund
3. I'll follow up personally next week to check your setup

The replacement ships tomorrow. Let me know if you need anything else!

Best,
TechMart Support
